finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed `retryCount` | Accept both names |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 warnings are real noise. They are `DEP*` deprecation notices from the bumped deps. Fixing them means touching `src/legacy` and dropping `punycode`.

Next: say the word and I clear the deprecations.
